hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the acting enemy.
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of part.
If the current form of part is not "3", then
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in aiArg, then
    Part changes to form "3".
    Part cancels its cast.
  Otherwise
    Let v be if the current form of part is "1" then the numeric entry "sun_shadow_transition_turn" in aiArg else the numeric entry "shadow_sun_transition_turn" in aiArg.
    Let v2 be if the current form of part is "1" then "2" else "1".
    Let v3 be the count "changeTurn".
    Count up "changeTurn".
    If v3 is more than v, then
      Part changes to form v2.
      Part cancels its cast.
      Reset the count "changeTurn".
Let list be the living enemies.
For each x in list
  If x is ready to act, then x → smart-lot-and-register-ability with ({healHpRate: 100}).

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
If arg meets the move condition {abilityId: the id of the move labelled "electra" on part}, then part uses (the id of the move labelled "electra_recovery" on part) immediately with options {skipStepCnt: true, skipAttackMotion: true} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true} and stop.
If [the id of the move labelled "sun_pole" on part, the id of the move labelled "shadow_pole" on part, the id of the move labelled "shadow_sun_pole" on part] contains the value "abilityId" of arg, then
  Let list be [].
  Let globalRegister be the register of this state.
  Let v be _ → filter with ([2, 3], given (n) { Return part n of the acting enemy is alive. }, this state).
  If v is not empty, then list → push with ([{builtin: "DIE_FORCIBLY", dieNos: v}], [{deformTag: "deformation_04", filteringDeformPosArray: v}]).
  Set list to list → concat with (a revive sequence {deformTag: globalRegister's 'abilityDeformConfMap' at (the value "abilityId" of arg)'s 'deformTag', nos: globalRegister's 'abilityDeformConfMap' at (the value "abilityId" of arg)'s 'childNos'}).
  Append [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the DISABLE_TARGET status, the HIDDEN_HP_GAUGE status], saChildNos: globalRegister's 'abilityDeformConfMap' at (the value "abilityId" of arg)'s 'childNos'}] to list.
  Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: list} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
